name: Star Number / Positive Recursive Teaching Dimension
details: A smallest positive teaching set at any recursive stage is a star centered at its target.
witness_verification: For the $n$-singleton class, star number is $n-1$, while positive recursive teaching dimension is $1$.
proof: Fix any positive recursive teaching order. At a stage with remaining family $\mathcal G$, target $h$, and a smallest positive teaching set $S$ of size $d$, minimality gives, for each $x\in S$, a concept $g_x\in\mathcal G\setminus\{h\}$ that is one on $S\setminus\{x\}$ and zero at $x$. The target is one on all of $S$, so its trace and the traces of the $g_x$ form a $d$-star in the projection of $\mathcal G$. Since star number is subfamily-monotonic, $\mathrm S(\mathcal H)\ge d$ for every stage of every positive recursive order. It therefore bounds the minimum possible maximum stage size $\mathrm{RTD}^+(\mathcal H)$.
